notes: Page headed 'BI-LINGUALISM.-continud.' (sic). Subsidiary-to-Pashto group continues on leaf 0282 (p.276: Hindustani cols 59-60, Western Pahari 61-62). Printed inconsistency: Pashto Total females, Lahore Division printed 1,156 but its districts (832+75+63+12+91+85) sum to 1,158; division figure agrees with British Territory total (7,496), district figures re-read at 200% and kept as printed. Note: manifest's part1/part2 leaf ranges are off by one - Part II begins on leaf 0279 (p.273). Amritsar Pashto Total females: second digit faint, reads 75 (5 vs 3 uncertain) and kept as 75; but 73 would reconcile both the Lahore Division total (1,156) and Amritsar's subsidiary columns (Punjabi 58 + leaf 0282 Hindustani/Western Pahari = 73), so the print or this reading may be at fault.
